summary: Best 28.841 (incumbent 28.628): a greedy tunnel dive to the field route's physical limit. Analysis: the field route past 28.6% is closed (free-flight bound + 12k brute-force flights: max 28.79%); the WR demo (analysis only) shows the real route, a ~2,000 u dip into a cavity with a surf-ramp turnaround. New generic novel-sampler options --respawn-novel-band / --respawn-novel-turn (+ a byte-identical 3-6x sampler speed-up) put ~85% of novel rows in that dip; a bench shows the return leg learned (climb -> room 5/11). T cap 2->1 gave the 28.841 eval and the first real episodes past the tunnel (ceiling 29.76%), but the warm greedy line then locked into the CP2 pit dive. From scratch the band clears the trap and the CP2 pit sooner than round 1 but stalls at the window. Next: band only for dips behind the frontier, and fix the greedy-vs-stochastic gap.
